retained_terms.Drake: 訓練家姓名語言表以同一英文鍵涵蓋勇次及源治，單一全域譯名會誤稱其中一人；此姓名鍵保留Drake，劇情則依事件分別翻譯。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Are you ready, kid? It's about to get interesting.
contextual_terms.reason: 柑橘競技場事件，橘子聯盟館主。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Don't think my age has slowed me down.
contextual_terms.reason: 同地圖另一個Drake事件為LEADER_Drake；依實際訓練家類型區分。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Close battle earlier. I know you'll beat the rest.
contextual_terms.reason: 宮門競技場此事件沿用勇次的圖像，不是源治的trchar172。
